info.title: Kekkai Sensen (ITA)
info.synopsis: Una breccia tra la Terra e il mondo di Beyond si è aperta nella città  di New York, intrappolando esseri umani e creature sovrannaturali come vampiri e lupi mannari in una nebbia misteriosa. A garantire gli equilibri della forzata convivenza è la società  segreta Libra, composta da superuomini e mostri e guidata dal licantropo Klaus V. Reinherz. Leo è un giornalista e fotografo che viene inaspettatamente reclutato per entrare nei loro ranghi.

episodes.title: Secret Society of the Magic-Sealed City
episodes.synopsis: Leonard Watch, an ordinary aspiring reporter, moves to Jerusalem's Lot, a city created by the intersection of worlds where New York City once stood, and through a series of lucky coincidences, is recruited into the secret society named "Libra."

episodes.title: After the Phantom Ghost Wagon
episodes.synopsis: While Zapp makes Leo's daytime job delivering pizzas a living hell, they spot a dry cleaning van that is more than it appears to be. When Leo is kidnapped, the rest of the Libra team must work together to rescue him from his captors.

episodes.title: A Game Between Two Worlds
episodes.synopsis: When the president is attacked by a man under the influence of a powerful synthetic drug called Angel Scale, Klaus and K.K. travel to the alterworld to challenge a Beyondian big wheel to a game of Prosfair in order to uncover the source of the drug.

episodes.title: Blood Line Fever
episodes.synopsis: The members of Libra discover, thanks to Leo's power, that vampires appeared in the city and the vampire hunter Blitz "Lucky" Abrahms arrives to assist them.

episodes.title: The Tremorous Blood Hammer
episodes.synopsis: Aligura, the Queen of Monomania, is on the hunt to find her creation, Brody & Hummer, and her monster truck is tearing up anything that gets in her way! Meanwhile, Femt and the King of Despair make some secret plans of their own.

episodes.title: Don`t Forget to Don`t Forget Me
episodes.synopsis: While out buying lunch for Zapp and himself, Leo befriends a mushroom-like Beyondian named Nej, who has a craving for hamburgers, but is unable to buy them from the segregated 42nd Street quarter where they are sold.

episodes.title: A No-Holds-Barred Eden
episodes.synopsis: Chasing down a rescue request from Zapp, Klaus and Leo find themselves in an underground cage-fighting arena, with Klaus winding up in the ring. Black and Leo hit it off over lunch at the diner, and learn that they have much in common.

episodes.title: Z`s Longest Day (Part 1)
episodes.synopsis: As Zapp's profligate lifestyle starts catching up with him, word comes in that a Blood Breed attack is coming to Hellsalem's Lot, but that someone outside of Libra is also involved. Black speaks to White about their relationship with Leo.

episodes.title: Z`s Longest Day (Part 2)
episodes.synopsis: While a crowd looks on, an airplane attempting to fly into Hellsalem's Lot carries Jugei's junior pupil--and the top half of the Blood Breed Libra was fighting! The King of Despair continues setting his plan in motion. The Libra team gains a new member.

episodes.title: Run! Lunch!! Run!!! / To the End.
episodes.synopsis: Zapp, Leo, and Zed embark upon a quest to find an agreeable restaurant at which to have lunch. Klaus, Starphase, and Abrams meet with the League of High Order Spirituals to confer about their concerns pertaining to the barrier surrounding the city.

episodes.title: Paint It Black
episodes.synopsis: Growing up on their parents' ranch, White struggles with being the only member of her family without the gift of psychic abilities, while Black is reluctant to stick up for himself and develop his own powers to their fullest.

episodes.title: "Hello, World!"
episodes.synopsis: The members of Libra gather to defend Leo as he rushes to reach the King of Despair in order to confront him, not only for Black and White's sake, but to save the city as well.

info.title: The Seven Knights of the Marronnier Kingdom
info.synopsis: Al centro di un continente formato da otto nazioni si trova il pacifico Regno di Marronnier. La carismatica generalessa del regno, Baribara, ha sette figli. Ciascuno di loro è un valoroso cavaliere ed è dotato di una bizzarra caratteristica innata, come non riuscire mai a dormire, saper addestrare le bestie o essere sempre affamato. Nonostante le loro stravaganti personalità, tutti condividono lo stesso grande obiettivo, ovvero salvare eroicamente una splendida principessa. Per stringere solide alleanze e mantenere la pace nel continente, i sette fratelli vengono inviati come ambasciatori diplomatici nei sette regni confinanti. Inizia così per ognuno di loro un viaggio ricco di insidie politiche, avventure e, soprattutto, l'incontro con la propria metà del destino.

episodes.title: I sette cavalieri
episodes.synopsis: At the heart of a continent of eight kingdoms lies the Marronnier Kingdom. Its general, Baribara, has seven sons, each with a unique gift and serving as a knight commander. Bound by a single noble cause of heroically rescuing a princess someday, the brothers set out as goodwill ambassadors to the seven neighboring kingdoms. What encounters, trials, and destinies await them in these unknown lands?

episodes.title: Primavera sul lago
episodes.synopsis: Chilly finds himself drawn to Bruno, unaware that it is Princess Brunhild disguised as a man. But after learning of a string of mysterious incidents surrounding her, he begins to suspect someone is working against her. He decides to uncover the truth when something strange occurs within him. Meanwhile, Insomniac is selected as the first goodwill ambassador, and his future fiancée is to be chosen.

episodes.title: Avventatezza
episodes.synopsis: Insomniac accepts his engagement to Ellie, the castellan's daughter, but conflicting motives begin to emerge behind the arrangement. During a sword tournament at the castle, Swordsman and Ellie advance to the semifinals, where they face off in a fierce duel. Later, Ellie learns she has been chosen to accompany Insomniac as a knight commander aide on his journey to the Country of Long Nights.

episodes.title: Eleonora
episodes.synopsis: As they journey to the Country of Long Nights, Ellie begins to notice subtle changes in Insomniac, whom she has known since childhood, that leave her uneasy. They arrive in a land where blue flowers bloom, and preparations are underway for the annual Walpurga Eve festival. But beneath its peaceful surface, Insomniac senses an ominous presence, and the country's hidden secrets slowly come to light.
